steps.note: The plan tracks initial scratch vectors a,c through rows 0-7 and states the net target change (JV+RG)x independently of a,c, as the paper does.
Bit case stated faithfully: central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side wires cancel exactly the intersection-one cases, self coefficient one.
Complex case stated faithfully: central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, side cancels intersections zero and two, intersection one contributes zero, self coefficient one.
The plan gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) via the inverse schedule X<-X-Y, with each invocation restoring its auxiliary wires.
The plan asserts that every edge joins comparable labels (S1.3.3.4) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions, i.e. the residual table.
S1.3.3.3 states <t_X> ⊂ t_Y^⊥ because t_X ⊥ t_Y, but omits the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2 that gives the 2->5 residual, so the defining content is only half stated.
The plan states the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 losing h, sources N, sinks Wm-N, the gate telescoping to Wm-2N, and the +2L for absolute changes.

The plan states that over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one vector, is nondegenerate and nonalternating, and hence has an orthonormal basis; the plane-absorption detail is not spelled out, but the claim and its reason match the paper.
Exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 stated, both below 1/2.
The plan gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U as a sum of wt(v)[v·x] over an orthonormal residual basis.
Odd weight gives phase i^{±[v·x]}, written as a two-term combination, and H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse, as in the paper.
The plan counts one kernel per residual vector (s_c in all) but never states the k-column tensor product, where each residual vector gives one factor acting on all k columns.

S1.5.1.5 names the Z signs, the i^{27f} scalar and negation of the X bank. It omits the frames I and C^{⊗m} of the zero and full labels, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) for X_a->Y_a, and the identity C=iZC^{-1}Z that does the repair.
L/N<1/2 is stated and used to give deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
η_b = 339/22587335000000 stated as the relative deficit of the bit network.
η_c = 73/19906842167500 stated as the relative deficit of the complex network.
Both deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}), hence s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}.
The plan gives elimination with the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular operations, one rank-one block per step, and exactly a ones in Π.

S1.3.7 says only 'q a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators' as a hypothesis. It does not say the prime must avoid the denominators of a finite table of factors and inverses, nor that the identities then specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
Lower-triangular transformation in O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from earlier unchanged coordinates.
Each one of Π is D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, one interchange each, a in all.
The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, m^10<B<m^11 and Δ=⌈C_0 d^{20}⌉ (S1.5.4, S1.5.4.1). It never defines C_0=128mB^2, ν, or C_1=max{20,ν+3}, so Δ is not fully specified.
The plan states A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes, at most 8e at leaves, and that each invocation adds at most E operations.
S1.5.4.1 asserts the depth bound 8B^2d^{12} but omits the unrolling inequality B^{k+1}≤B^2d^ν and the final comparison of the total with C_0d^{C_1}, so it states the result without the step.
Depth ℓ means values in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ℓ, p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer bits suffice, and 20ε<1 gives Δ=o(p).
Absolute row sum one preserves disks and the single final truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P10 covers the bank-exchange network (4/4), most of the label budget (3/5: the residual table and the h-2 complement on edge 2->5 are missing), the core of the phase interface (2/4: the k-column tensoring and the endpoint frame repair are missing), all of the rank saving (4/4), most of the matrix shear (3/4: the prime is only a hypothesis, with no specialization argument), and three of five simultaneous-layer steps (C_0/C_1 and the unrolling inequality are missing). 19 of 26 present, none wrong.
